collectShippingAddress.description: Indicates whether to skip the collection of the shipping address from the customer during the agreement sign-up phase.

enableAddressChange.description: Indicates whether to show the shipping address but prevent the customer from editing it.

experienceId.description: The ID of the experience profile to apply during the agreement approval UI flow.

externalSelectedFundingInstrumentType.description: The type of financial instrument (FI) that the merchant wants to promote.
